_about: Corrections to the reference scales (supporting-docs/raaga_reference_*.json), checked against published sources on 12 Nov 2026 and applied by tools/build_pages.py over the reference. Each entry keeps what the reference said ('was'). There is no musician review: the sources decide.

Hussēnī.was: S N2 D2 P M1 G2 R2 S  [karnatik/sujamusic notate D1 here but Huseni uses chatushruti dhaivatam D2, likely a typo, expert to verify]
Hussēnī.now: S N2 D1 P M1 G2 R2 S
Hussēnī.why: The descent takes shuddha dhaivatam (D1); the reference had called D1 a typo, but four sources give it.

Ānandabhairavi.why: ragasurabhi, karnatik, darbar and the List of Janya ragas place it under the 20th mela.

Sāma.was: Sources disagree: ragasurabhi and karnatik classify it as janya of 28th mela Harikambhoji; some sources place it under 29th mela Shankarabharanam (no nishadha, so fits either). Expert to confirm
Sāma.why: Both sources give the 28th mela; none found for the 29th.

Yaman kalyāṇ.was: S' N D P M G R S
Yaman kalyāṇ.now: S' N D P M G, G m G R S
Yaman kalyāṇ.why: Shuddh ma enters in the descent (G m G), which is what sets it apart from Yaman.

Jōg.was: S G M P n S'
Jōg.now: S G m P n S'
Jōg.why: Jog's madhyam is shuddh (m); M on these pages means tivra.

Jōg.was: S' n P M g S
Jōg.now: S' n P m g S
Jōg.why: Shuddh ma (m), as in the aroh.

Ābhōgī.was: S R g M D S'
Ābhōgī.now: S R g m D S'

Ābhōgī.was: S' D M g R S
Ābhōgī.now: S' D m g R S
Ābhōgī.why: Shuddh ma (m), as in the aroh.

Madhuvanti.was: .N S g M P N S'
Madhuvanti.now: N. S g M P N S'
Madhuvanti.why: Notation: a lower-octave note is written with the dot after it (N.).

Tōḍī.was: S r g M P d N S'
Tōḍī.now: S r g M d N S'
Tōḍī.why: The common aroh skips Pa; the form with Pa is also printed but is less usual.
